summary: InterCure Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 24, 2026, announcing a final settlement with Israeli authorities for war-related indirect damages from the October 7, 2023 attacks. The settlement totals NIS 230 million (~$77 million), compared to an original claim exceeding NIS 300 million, with NIS 101 million already advanced. Proceeds will fund rehabilitation of its Nir Oz facility. This is a litigation/govt compensation settlement, not a corporate special situation.
